azure.uami_client_id: <client id of the user-assigned managed identity (CloudBAU-Automation)>

gcp.key_secret_name: <name of the Key Vault secret holding the service-account JSON key>

logic_app.url_secret_name: <name of the Key Vault SECRET (letters, digits, dashes) that holds the block/unblock Logic App 'HTTP POST URL'>

email_logic_app.url_secret_name: <name of the Key Vault secret holding the EMAIL Logic App 'HTTP POST URL'>

host_vm: <name of the VM this app runs on - it is never stopped by the scheduler>
